text:
Jennison Associates LLC Has Increased Astrazeneca Plc (AZN) Holding by $798.34 Million; Market Valuation Rose Posted by Palma Niemeyer on December 18, 2018 at 4:17 pm
Jennison Associates Llc increased its stake in Astrazeneca Plc (AZN) by 106.21% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jennison Associates Llc bought 20.47M shares as the company’s stock rose 1.75% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 39.74M shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $1.57B, up from 19.27 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jennison Associates Llc who had been investing in Astrazeneca Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $97.08B market cap company. The stock increased 0.08% or $0.03 during the last trading session, reaching $38.38. About 962,548 shares traded. AstraZeneca PLC (NYSE:AZN) has risen 19.21% since December 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 19.21% the S&P500.
Jennison Associates Llc, which manages about $108.60B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 318,931 shares to 15.64M shares, valued at $3.53B in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Hyatt Hotels Corp (NYSE:H) by 247,136 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 545,706 shares, and cut its stake in Wsfs Finl Corp (NASDAQ:WSFS).

AstraZeneca PLC (NYSE:AZN) Ratings Coverage

As per Tuesday, December 11, the company rating was reinitiated by Jefferies. The company was downgraded on Thursday, August 16 by Jefferies.
